tagline: The claim on one side, the record on the other. Every case video and Short, in one place.

guides.title: How Each Case Works
guides.body: Every case takes a claim people repeat with total confidence, puts it on one side, and puts the actual record on the other. The full video walks the evidence to a verdict. The Shorts are single claims, stated the way people state them, with the answer in the full case.

guides.title: Case One: The NATO Driving Permit
guides.body: The first case on the channel: the secret NATO driving permit that supposedly lets you drive without a license. The record says it is a translation booklet. The full case and both of its Shorts are in this list.

guides.title: How To Use This App
guides.body: Every video on the channel is listed here, newest first. Search by a word in the title. Tap any video to watch it on YouTube, and tap the star to save a favorite. The list refreshes itself from the channel feed when you open the app, so new videos appear here with no app update.
